name: Herman Takatsukin
source:
A pharmaceutical researcher and development chief once scouted by the Major.

He has developed various medicines, tools, and devices using technology that can now only be thought of as magic, but in fact he is literally originally a magician from another world.


[Translated from [url=https://www.turumiku.jp/product/gouhou/#character_sub]the official site[/url]]
